title: tooling-gaps: scope enforcement fires on files written by the current run
description: RealToolExecutor's read-before-write scope enforcement rejects patch_file on files the current run itself created via write_file. The enforcement correctly tracks only reads, not writes. This forces a redundant read_file on a file whose content the agent already holds in context from the write call.
proposed_resolution: Extend scope enforcement to track write_file paths alongside read_file paths; a file the current run wrote is already in scope for subsequent modifications without a redundant read.
